beats.say: Harry Kane won the Ballon d'Or at the London Palladium ceremony.
The 70th annual ceremony saw Kane beat thirty other world class nominees. That is more players than you would find on two full football team sheets.
The Bayern Munich striker finished ahead of runners up Kylian Mbappe and Lamine Yamal on Monday 26 October.
It is a massive moment for English football because no Englishman had won it for twenty five years.
The Guardian says Downing Street is even hinting at a knighthood for the captain following his victory.
By ending a quarter century wait, Kane has finally matched the achievement of Michael Owen in 2001.
